pages.title: Wooden Plate
pages.text: The wooden plate is $(thing)for display$(): right-click with a food to set it on the plate, sneak and right-click empty-handed to turn it 45°, and right-click empty-handed to pop the food back out.$(br2)Some items — potatoes, berries, raw and cooked fish, apples, golden apples and others — get their own models.

pages.title: Glass Cup
pages.text: Up to $(thing)four cups can stack in one block$(); placing them one at a time stacks them up, and breaking them returns the right number.
